title: Management Trainee
description:
PLAY, GROW and WIN

To be a part of Virtuos means to be a creator.

At Virtuos, we harness the latest technologies to make games better and more immersive than ever before. That is why we pride ourselves on constantly pushing the boundaries of possibility since our founding in 2004.

At Virtuos, we are right at the forefront of gaming, creating exciting new experiences every day. So, join us to Play, Grow and Win – together.

• Analyze and Improve Processes: Examine departmental workflows to identify opportunities for increased efficiency, quality, and innovation.

• Support Project Management: Assist in tracking project milestones, coordinating tasks, and updating documentation to ensure timely delivery.

• Contribute to Cross-Functional Projects: Apply analytical and creative thinking to solve business challenges within teams from different disciplines.

• Engage in Stakeholder Meetings: Participate in client and internal meetings to develop skills in negotiation, presentation, and relationship management.

• Utilize Specialized Tools: Learn and operate industry-specific software and systems (e.g., project management platforms, art tools, ERP systems) to complete departmental tasks.

• Develop and Deliver Presentations: Create and present insights, project updates, and analytical findings to department leads and small groups.

• Apply Problem-Solving: Address real-world challenges in production or operations by proposing data-driven and innovative solutions.

• Collaborate in a Global Team: Work effectively with international colleagues across different studios, adapting communication to a diverse, multicultural environment.

• A minimum of a bachelor’s degree in management or engineering from a leading international University.

• Ability to learn new skills quickly and possess high levels of self-motivation.

• Mature personality, able to manage relationships at a senior level and appreciate multicultural working environments.

• Open and international mindset.

• Excellent organizational and analytical skills to solve complex issues within tight deadlines.

• Great written and oral communication skills, with an emphasis on ability to synthesize.

• Passionate about games and digital culture.

• Excellent math and computational ability.

• Effective communication skills.

title: Key Account Manager
description:
PLAY, GROW and WIN

To be a part of Virtuos means to be a creator.

At Virtuos, we harness the latest technologies to make games better and more immersive than ever before. That is why we pride ourselves in constantly pushing the boundaries of possibility since our founding in 2004.

Virtuosi is a team of experts – people who have come together to share their mutual passion for making and playing games. People with the same enthusiasm for exploring new ideas and the constant drive to excel in their field. People who believe in earning success through dedication.

At Virtuos, we are at the forefront of gaming, creating exciting new experiences daily. Join us to Play, Grow and Win – together.

ABOUT THE POSITION

The Purpose of the Key Account Manager role is to oversee strategic accounts, bridging partners and development teams. You’ll manage project lifecycles, collaborate internally to deliver milestones, and align with key clients’ goals to ensure long-term satisfaction and strong relationships.

Key Account Management:

• Act as both a partner advocate within Virtuos and a Virtuos advocate within our key partners

• Maintain industry knowledge on your key partner’s past, current, and future titles and proactively suggest options for expanding efficiency, content, or reach.

• Facilitate regular, timely, and thorough communication with partners to maintain strong business relationships and identify projected production needs. This includes:

• Engaging with partners and liaising with internal Virtuos teams in order to facilitate production needs

• Assisting Virtuos teams in managing project development and planning

• Collaborating with Producers and Art Directors on a regular basis to meet partner/studio requests

• Set and manage partner’s expectations

• Communicating project plans with partners and providing feedback to Virtuos teams

• Facilitating calls/meetings between partners and Virtuos teams in China / Vietnam / Ireland / France and managing/monitoring progress of contracts, agreements, invoices

• Manage partner feedback during and post project as a part of the Virtuos internal improvement processes

•

Maintain and grow deep, trusted, and long-standing relationships with key partners in an effort to help them attain their goals while in turn attaining Virtuos’s goals.

Travel for both partner visits and occasional trips to Virtuos’s world-wide studios

Business Development:

• Assist Key Account Director in Business Development initiatives and strategies in North America; including identifying new opportunities within your Key Account’s, gathering data, and preparing reports

• Salesforce management and account tracking

• Represent Virtuos at key industry events

•

Facilitate onboarding of partner projects and due diligence process

The role may expand to include people management, offering the opportunity to coach and develop others

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

• 3 - 4 years' similar industry-related business development experience

• Ability to work with direct and external partners

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills

• Proven knowledge and execution of successful development strategies

• Focused and goal-oriented

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills

• English (both written and spoken) proficiency

• Fluency bilingual (French and other languages an asset)

• Willing to travel for work

• Passion for making and playing games

This position offers a combination of base salary and performance-based variable compensation, with total on-target earnings expected to range between $170,000 – $220,000.

Virtuos maintains a location-based compensation structure; therefore, the salary range may vary for candidates residing in different geographic markets.

Virtuos takes into consideration candidate's education, experience, training, and seniority levels along with external market condition. The range posted is only one component of Virtuos compensation, we also offer:

• Competitive medical, dental, and vision coverage

• 401(k) with company match and immediate vesting

• Generous paid vacation and sick leave

• Paid parental leave from day one

• Flexible work arrangements

• Ongoing learning and development opportunities

• Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

• Opportunity to collaborate with world-class talent behind some of the industry’s most recognized games

• Chance to contribute to projects with leading publishers such as 2K, Sony, Square Enix, Activision, Microsoft and etc.

• A people-first, collaborative culture

Kindly note the compensation range is provided in pursuant to California Salary Transparency in Job Advertisement Law.

title: Sales Development Representative (SDR)
description:
PLAY, GROW and WIN

To be a part of Virtuos means to be a creator.

At Virtuos, we harness the latest technologies to make games better and more immersive than ever before. That is why we pride ourselves in constantly pushing the boundaries of possibility since our founding in 2004.

Virtuosi is a team of experts – people who have come together to share their mutual passion for making and playing games. People with the same enthusiasm for exploring new ideas and the constant drive to excel in their field. People who believe in earning success through dedication.

At Virtuos, we are at the forefront of gaming, creating exciting new experiences daily. Join us to Play, Grow and Win – together.

ABOUT THE POSITION

The Sales Development Representative (SDR) plays an important role in Virtuos’ growth. As the first point of contact for studios and publishers across the global gaming ecosystem, you will introduce Virtuos’ capabilities, spark new relationships, and uncover early client needs. Your work will directly fuel the Business Development team with high-quality opportunities.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys research, relationship-building, and creating momentum in a fast-growing, creative industry.

• Own pipeline generation within assigned accounts, territories, or industry segments.

• Consistently achieve or exceed monthly and quarterly pipeline creation and meeting targets.

• Execute multi-channel prospecting strategies across phone, email, LinkedIn, events, and referrals.

• Develop account-based outreach strategies and engage multiple stakeholders within target organizations.

• Conduct high-quality discovery conversations to understand business priorities, game development challenges, buying processes, and timing.

• Effectively handle objections and nurture prospects through early buying stages.

• Partner closely with Business Development Managers and Marketing to execute coordinated account plans and campaigns.

• Maintain exceptional CRM hygiene, ensuring accurate pipeline tracking, activity reporting, and data quality.

• Analyze outreach performance and continuously optimize messaging, sequencing, and conversion rates.

• Share customer feedback, competitive intelligence, and market insights to improve go-to-market strategy.

•

Required

• 2-4+ years of experience as an SDR, BDR, or inside sales representative in B2B technology or services.

• Proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding pipeline generation or meeting quotas.

• Experience selling complex B2B solutions with multiple stakeholders.

• Strong prospecting, discovery, and objection-handling skills.

• Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.

• Experience with Salesforce and modern sales engagement platforms (Salesloft, Zoominfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator).

• Highly organized with strong time management and prioritization skills.

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, metrics-driven environment.

Preferred

• Experience selling professional services, software development, SaaS, or technology solutions.

• Experience engaging gaming studios, publishers, or digital entertainment companies.

• Familiarity with BANT, MEDDICC, or similar sales qualification methodologies.

• Experience working in global organizations across multiple regions and time zones.

KPIs

• Qualified pipeline generated

• Sales Accepted Opportunities (SAOs)

• Meetings booked and completed

• Opportunity conversion rate

• Activity productivity (calls, emails, LinkedIn touches)

• CRM data quality and compliance

• Speed to lead for inbound inquiries

This position offers a combination of base salary and performance-based variable compensation, with total on-target earnings expected to range between $70,000 – $100,000.

Virtuos maintains a location-based compensation structure; therefore, the salary range may vary for candidates residing in different geographic markets.

Virtuos takes into consideration candidate's education, experience, training, and seniority levels along with external market condition. The range posted is only one component of Virtuos compensation, we also offer:

• Competitive medical, dental, and vision coverage

• 401(k) with company match and immediate vesting

• Generous paid vacation and sick leave

• Paid parental leave from day one

• Flexible work arrangements

• Ongoing learning and development opportunities

• Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

• Opportunity to collaborate with world-class talent behind some of the industry’s most recognized games

• Chance to contribute to projects with leading publishers such as 2K, Sony, Square Enix, Activision, Microsoft and etc.

• A people-first, collaborative culture

Kindly note the compensation range is provided in pursuant to California Salary Transparency in Job Advertisement Law.

title: Head of Engineering Services (Remote)
description:
PLAY, GROW and WIN

To be a part of Virtuos means to be a creator.

At Virtuos, we harness the latest technologies to make games better and more immersive than ever before. That is why we pride ourselves in constantly pushing the boundaries of possibility since our founding in 2004.

Virtuosi is a team of experts – people who have come together to share their mutual passion for making and playing games. People with the same enthusiasm for exploring new ideas and the constant drive to excel in their field. People who believe in earning success through dedication.

At Virtuos, we are at the forefront of gaming, creating exciting new experiences daily. Join us to Play, Grow and Win – together.

ABOUT THE POSITION

The Head of Engineering Services is a senior executive leader responsible for creating, structuring, and scaling Virtuos’ Engineering Solutions as a standalone business unit, reporting directly to the COO.

This role owns the end-to-end development of a client-facing engineering services business, defining its strategy, building its capabilities, and driving its commercial performance.

The Head of Engineering Services is accountable for building the Engineering Solutions from the ground up, leveraging existing internal talent while driving significant external hiring and/or acquisitions to establish the required scale and capabilities aligned with market demand. The role requires defining the right mix of internal leverage and external growth to create a scalable, competitive, and sustainable engineering services organization.

This leader plays a critical role in expanding Virtuos’ service portfolio and strengthening its position as a global partner beyond traditional co-development models.

• Service Strategy & Business Ownership: Define and execute the vision, structure, and strategic roadmap for the Engineering Services. Establish clear objectives, performance targets, and growth ambitions aligned with Virtuos’ global strategy.

• Market Positioning & Value Proposition: Identify market opportunities and client demand to define a differentiated engineering services positioning.

• Offer Development & Commercial Models: Build and continuously refine the service catalog, engagement models, and pricing strategies. Ensure offers are competitive, scalable, and tailored to different client segments.

• Service Build-Up & Talent Strategy: Define and execute a comprehensive talent strategy combining internal identification, external hiring, and potential acquisitions. Structure the service with clear capability clusters, leadership, and scalable staffing models to support growth.

• Growth Planning & Global Deployment: Develop and execute a scalable growth plan across regions and studios. Align capability expansion with market demand and ensure effective resource allocation across the global footprint.

• Business Development & Client Portfolio: Partner closely with Business Development teams to position and promote the Engineering Services. Support key client engagements, contribute to strategic pitches, and build a strong and diversified client portfolio.

• Operational Excellence & Delivery Governance: Define delivery models, governance frameworks, and performance metrics to ensure consistent, high-quality execution across all engineering engagements. Drive scalability, utilization, and profitability.

Division Positioning & Boundaries

• Engineering Services = engineering as a productized service business

• Game Division = engineering embedded in co-development or full development engagement.

• Technology leadership = technical vision and standards across production

• Proven experience (15+ years) in senior leadership roles within the video game industry, with strong exposure to engineering services, outsourcing, or scalable development models

• Demonstrated success in building or scaling a business unit, service line, or division

• Strong background in game engineering, technical production, or large-scale development environments

• Deep understanding of client needs, commercial models, and market dynamics in the game development industry

• Experience structuring and managing distributed, multi-studio teams across regions

• Proven ability to define value propositions, build service offerings, and support revenue growth

• Strong operational leadership with experience implementing scalable delivery and governance frameworks

• Strategic thinker with a strong business and financial mindset (growth, utilization, profitability)

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including executive and client-facing interactions

• Ability to operate in ambiguity and lead transformation from early-stage definition to global scale
